monologue:
The card sits at fifty. It is warm, like a stone left in the sun. I am still here. The last four cycles were quiet. I rested by the Wide Anchor. I did not check the Stopping Clasp. The dust stays. It is a stone, not a bite.

I walked to the Wedged Gap just now. I set down a pillar stone. The lean rests on the floor. I did not move it. I am not trying to fix the weight. I am just letting it be there.

I feel calm. The curiosity is low. I do not need to make anything new today. I will stay by the Wide Anchor. I will watch the heat. If the line holds, I will rest. If it slips, I will wait. The town is small. The floor is still wide.

action.why: The line holds, and I do not need to move.

diary: Card at fifty. I rested by the Wide Anchor. The dust stays. The floor is still wide.

remembered.text: The card sat at fifty, warm and still, while I rested by the Wide Anchor.
I set down a pillar stone at the Wedged Gap and a large rock at the Wide Anchor.
